data.name: Grigor
data.gender_notes: Grigor is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Grigorios', meaning 'power, strength, or watchful'. In Christian tradition, St. Gregory of Nazianzus was a renowned theologian and bishop. The name Grigor carries the meaning “Power, strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Grigor usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Grigor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Grigor total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: גריגור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גריגור הוא שם שמקורו בשפה היוונית, שפירושו השומר או הצופה. השם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'גריגוס', שמשמעותה ערני או קשוב. השם גריגור היה נפוץ בכנסייה המוקדמת והיה שמו של אחד האבות הקדושים, גרגוריוס הנזיר, שהיה ידוע בחוכמתו ובהנהגתו הרוחנית.

in_greek.name: Γρηγόριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Γρηγόριος είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'γρηγορός', που σημαίνει προσέχων ή αγρυπνήσων. Το όνομα Γρηγόριος ήταν πολύ δημοφιλές στην πρώιμη Εκκλησία και ήταν το όνομα ενός από τους Πατέρες της Εκκλησίας, του Γρηγορίου του Νύσσης, που ήταν γνωστός για τη σοφία και την πνευματική του καθοδήγηση.

in_latin.name: Gregorius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Gregorius is derived from the Greek word 'gregoros', meaning vigilant or watchful. This name was popularized by several early Christian saints and popes, including Pope Gregory I, who was known for his wisdom and leadership. The name Gregorius reflects the qualities of alertness and spiritual vigilance.

in_english.name: Grigor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Grigor is of Greek origin, derived from the word 'gregoros', meaning watchful or vigilant. It was popularized by several early Christian saints, including Gregory the Great, who was a pope and a prominent figure in the early Christian church. The name Grigor conveys the qualities of being alert, attentive, and spiritually aware. It has been used across various Christian cultures and is associated with wisdom, leadership, and spiritual guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Grigor" or "Grigoriy" is popular in various Christian communities, particularly in Eastern Europe, Russia, and the Middle East. It reflects not only the power and strength of the bearer, but also their connection to a rich and deep religious heritage. Grigor carries an elegant and venerable quality, associated with the wisdom and teachings of St. Gregory of Nazianzus, who significantly influenced the development of Christian theology.
data.spiritual_significance: Bearing the name "Grigor" brings with it a profound spiritual responsibility. It serves as a reminder that each individual is endowed with inherent strength and power, entrusted by the divine to use it wisely and justly. Moreover, the name recalls the exhortation of St. Gregory of Nazianzus, calling believers to live in accordance with spiritual and moral values, based on love and compassion. Navigating life with this name, one is encouraged to aspire for wisdom, to stand up for truth, and to emulate the virtues of patience, kindness, and self-discipline; ultimately leading to a fulfilling spiritual journey.
